density.citation: R. N. Abdullaev, R. A. Khairulin, S. V. Stankus, Density and thermal expansion of silver in the solid and liquid states, J. Phys.: Conf. Ser. 1677 (2020) 012161, DOI 10.1088/1742-6596/1677/1/012161, Eq. (2), Table 1
density.mass_basis: 64 * ASE Ag mass 107.8682 g/mol / Avogadro constant 6.02214076e23 mol^-1
density.measurement_pressure: not numerically reported; <5 mPa in the paper refers only to sample degassing pretreatment
density.uncertainty_interpretation: conservative scale covering adjacent published Table 1 errors (0.25% at 1234.93 K and 0.26% at 1300 K); not a published 1250 K uncertainty or confidence interval

dynamics.ase_unit_conversion: timestep = 0.5 * ase.units.fs; friction = 0.01 / ase.units.fs; calculator outputs eV, eV/A and eV/A^3
dynamics.cell_dynamics: none; cell, atom count and PBC fixed
dynamics.engine: ASE 3.29.0 EAM calculator using the exact setfl file above
dynamics.integrator_and_ensemble: ASE Langevin NVT, fixed cubic cell, FixCom constraint, Langevin fixcm=False
dynamics.segment_temperature_schedule: steps 0 through 999 target 1600 K (the existing hot-start stage); no cooling or 1250 K equilibration is included in this pilot
dynamics.temperature_dof: 3N-3 = 189 after FixCom; use ASE constraint-aware temperature; no rotational constraints
dynamics.thermostat_rng: PCG64 child stream 3, checkpoint exact bit-generator state after every completed step boundary

initial_structure_generator.algorithm: sequential periodic random rejection packing; independent of a crystal; each trial draws one point uniformly in [0,L)^3; accept only if periodic minimum-image distance to every already placed atom is >= r_min; preserve insertion order as atom IDs 1..64; no retries with a different seed, no cell change, no clipping or relaxation
initial_structure_generator.overlap_rejection: reject candidate if any periodic minimum-image pair distance is strictly less than 2.2 A; require exactly 64 accepted atoms within 200000 trial points or fail without relaxing r_min
initial_structure_generator.packing_draw_order: one three-component uniform draw per candidate; rejected candidates consume packing stream; never restart stream on rejection
initial_structure_generator.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64) seeded by SeedSequence(master_seed).spawn(3); child streams in fixed order: packing, velocity initialization, Langevin thermostat
initial_structure_generator.velocity_initialization: ASE 3.29.0 MaxwellBoltzmannDistribution with force_temp=True at 1600 K using the velocity child stream and FixCom constraint; no velocity redraw or reseed

potential.ASE_neighbor_requirement: retain ASE integer periodic image offsets; cutoff exceeds half the 64-atom box, so minimum-image-only and index-deduplicated neighbor lists are forbidden
potential.applicability: pure-Ag EAM fitted to experimental and first-principles solid properties; paper reports a solid-liquid-interface melting estimate 1267 +/- 5 K versus experimental 1235 K and Cu-Ag phase-diagram work, while liquid configurations were not fitting targets. Suitable only for this exploratory Ag64 sampler pilot; not evidence of 1250 K equilibrium, finite-size accuracy, or MACE-quality labels.
potential.format: LAMMPS setfl alloy; one element Ag, Z=47
potential.radial_tail_policy: C_APPROVED_PUBLISHED_SETFL_ONE_BIN_ZERO_TAIL; exact source hash required; only the documented one-grid-bin near-zero tail
potential.scientific_use_basis: NIST-published scientific-use instructions plus the user's supplied legally obtained file and explicit research request
potential.source_citation: P. L. Williams, Y. Mishin, J. C. Hamilton, An embedded-atom potential for the Cu-Ag system, Modelling Simul. Mater. Sci. Eng. 14 (2006) 817-833, DOI 10.1088/0965-0393/14/5/002
potential.source_parameter_sha_evidence: user-supplied NIST download record and matching file; NIST release-notes PDF SHA256 262d9102f5a77572792b9a1d72f6c55c01372ec798f3321285d76246446a8c53

scope.seed_selection: first unused rho100 seed after the existing planned seed IDs 125010001 and 125010002; does not reassign or alter E/F tasks
